seeds_note: Genuine capture from the reporter's Home Assistant diagnostics download for an AIM-H04N Wi-Fi kit fronting five indoor subdevices (issue #789). device0 is the kit master's /device/0 (model AIM-H04N, 'OCF Wi-Fi Kit'); seeds are the five siblings' own /<uuid>/device/0 Collection responses, one SAC_BIG_SLIM1WAY (living room) and four SAC_SLIM1WAY. oic_res is the kit's real /oic/res. All five siblings report the same outdoor-unit reading on /temperatures/outside/vs/0 (13.9 C). Scrubbed: serialNum/otnDUID/deviceId/masterUuid were already **REDACTED** in the download; the OCF device-id UUIDs (di/pi and the subdevice prefixes) are replaced with 00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000120000N placeholders. subdeviceIdList on the master /subdevices/vs/0 arrived redacted and is restored here to the five placeholder UUIDs the siblings answer on, so Pattern B enumeration runs.
